criticisms: The Data Caveats section, while present and substantive, contains only two bullet points; a third caveat (e.g., noting that the sample_events list is a partial sample and may not represent all 79 events, or that depth accuracy varies by network) would strengthen this section.

The Top Signals section lists four items, which meets the minimum of three, but the fourth item (Mohr, Iran) is somewhat less developed than the others and could benefit from a brief note on regional tectonic context.
Minor: the report does not explicitly note the absence of daily count data for 2026-01-26 and several other dates, which could be a data gap worth flagging in caveats.
